alignment.anchorMeaning: Root-provided incomplete bootstrap endedAt, used as fatal-neighborhood alignment proxy; no exact failing packet/action timestamp independently established.
alignment.baseSelection: Rows received by public stderr capture within inclusive observation-time bounds; observedAtMs is receive time and is not necessarily actual stage completion time.
alignment.storeOverlapSelection: Additionally compute approximate max completed occurrence intervals as startedUnixMs+maxStartUs/1000 through startedUnixMs+maxEndUs/1000; integer Unix origin and diagnostic receive delay limit precision.

resource.definition: Nearest-rank unweighted distributions of sampled public monitor values; rates describe each preceding observation interval, not continuous maxima.

terminal.reasonScope: Operator requested load drain is monitor cleanup reason after the original Root-reported AOI fatal, not a replacement original failure.

fatalNeighborhood.connectionScope: Opaque public connection numbers only; no gameplay actor/request linkage established here.

limits: Slow/Store datasets contain completed emitted observations at a >=50ms threshold; missing rows do not exclude incomplete waits, subthreshold work or uninstrumented paths.
Nested runtime/execute/input/outbound and same-trace Store stages overlap and must not be summed into one request duration.
Before/after classifications refer to diagnostic receive time; stderr batching and scheduler delay prevent exact packet-level causality.
Bootstrap includes admission and settle, not a measured stage; post-anchor rows and monitor observations can include drain work.
Low sampled total CPU/RAM use does not exclude a saturated logical core, serialized lock/queue, scheduler stalls or between-sample resource spikes. Host core utilization includes unrelated processes.
Windows process I/O is file/device I/O, not disk latency/physical IOPS; host NIC data can exclude loopback and process network rates are absent.
No gameplay samples raw, old run or CPU profile was read. No actor/request AOI correlation, root cause, capacity upper bound or acceptance is inferred.
